m: {Mario} warps up a green pipe {Inside} the {Hangar} and stomps a clump of *prickly grass*, expecting a coin. Instead a bristly **awn** spears straight through his boot. He head-butts the next block, and out pops another spiky **awn**, then a hundred more, until his moustache bristles like a wheat field and he hops away yelling "Wahoo!" in pain.

{James Bond} straightens his tuxedo in {Front} of the {Inn} as Q hands him a *bamboo* cane with a giant *rib* on the end. One click and a stretchy **tendon** shoots out, catapulting him over the villain's wall. He lands unruffled, plucks the **tendon** like a cello, and remarks that Q is a little highly strung.

{Pikachu} sparks into the {Bathroom} of the {Inn} and squeals "Pika!" into a *knight*'s *ear*, which apparently means you're hired. A tiny Thunderbolt jolts the armour to attention, so Pikachu can **employ** him to scrub the tub. He goes on to **employ** a goose and a mop, paying everyone in static.

{Gandalf} raps his staff in {Front} of the {Boathouse} and mutters a spell over a heap of *gold coins*, which melt and curl into a shining *hook*. The enchanted **hook** flies off on its own, snags a whale, a rowboat and the moon's reflection, and drags them all ashore. Cranky but pleased, he hangs the **hook** on his pointy hat.

{Gandalf} arrives in the {Bathroom} of the {Casino} exactly when he means to, and finds his staff has been pawned. Cranky, he zaps a potted *tree* with a spell and it shrivels into one plain **stick**. An *insect* clinging to the twig is knighted Keeper of the **stick** and sails it off to the roulette table like a broom.

{Robocop} clanks down to the {Basement} of the {Hangar}, where a giant *mouth* wearing an *embroidered robe* is breaking Directive Nine: no singing. His visor locks on and he reads the rule out at full volume, so the mouth starts to **shout** back. Now they both **shout**, steel man and robed lips, until every rivet shakes loose and is politely arrested.

{Shrek} stomps into the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange} wanting to be left alone, but a *wellspring* is gurgling across the tiles, glittering under the *moon*. It comes from a swollen **gland** in his own neck, squirting swamp water with every grumpy roar. Donkey will not shut up about it, so Shrek roars louder, and the **gland** soaks every banker in the queue.

{Shrek} sits {Inside} the {Yen Exchange} peeling an onion when Donkey starts to sing. To drown him out, Shrek bends a *bow* from a teller's rail and pulls a *dark thread* out of his sock for its **string**. One grumpy pluck booms through the vault, coins hop, bankers dance, and Donkey, thrilled, demands the **string** for his solo.

{Yoshi} flutter-jumps over a *trap pit* in the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} and spots a *campfire* blazing at the bottom. Out shoots the long tongue, and down goes one hot **flame**. His eyes water, his tail smokes, and he lays a glowing egg with a **flame** dancing through its shell, which the butler uses to light his candles.

{Sherlock} peers through his magnifying glass in the {Basement} of the {Water Park} and deduces from one wet hair that a *woman* with a long *beard* is nearby, and bored. "Elementary," he says, "she wants someone to **play with** it." Watson braids it, Sherlock swings on it, and soon she lets the lifeguards **play with** it as a water slide.

{Frodo} plods into the {Basement} of the {Pool} and meets a *standing person* so tall his head has poked up into a *mansion* overhead. Wearily, Frodo begins another very long walk, up the trouser leg and over the collar, to the mansion's carpet. There he makes the mistake of trying to **look down**: Sam is a dot, and the Ring swings over the hole, begging him to **look down** again.

{Lara Croft} squeezes {Inside} the {Beach} through a sand tunnel and finds a *cliff* sheltering an ancient *village*, exactly **one hundredth** of normal size. She plucks the thimble-sized relic from its temple, and a boulder the size of a pea rolls after her ankle. Even the trap is **one hundredth** of a trap, so she backflips over it, yawning.

{Lara Croft} vaults into the {Bathroom} of the {Jungle} temple, ponytail flying, and a stone door grinds open on a *standing heart* doing the cha-cha. No puzzle, trap or relic in her notes covers this, so all she can do is **stare blankly**. A boulder rolls up behind her, stops, and seems to **stare blankly** at the dancing heart too.

{Sherlock} examines one crumb of concrete in the {Bathroom} of the {Spa} and announces that a **tall building** has appeared overnight. "Elementary, Watson: mortar in the soap." He throws open the window and, sure enough, the *summer* sun has baked the *cliff* opposite into a **tall building**, which adds a floor every time he says he told them so.

{Kermit} flails down to the {Basement} of the {Funfair}, where the show is falling apart and the stagehands fix him with a *glare*. He clutches his banjo, his green *heart* hammering, and sings the most **earnest** song a frog ever sang, begging them to carry on. He ends on a tiny "Yaaay?", arms waving, so **earnest** that even the candy floss cries.

{Robocop} clanks {Inside} the {Tower}, visor glowing, and politely arrests an *emperor* for stealing a *side dish* of cold broccoli. The emperor drops to his knees and begs him to **spare** him. A directive scrolls across the targeting display: first offence, vegetables returned. Stiffly he reads it aloud, agrees to **spare** the emperor, and handcuffs the broccoli instead.

{Darth Vader} breathes loudly in {Front} of the {Boxing Ring} and lifts a sack of *gold coins* with the Force, then a giant *nail*. One gesture of his glove and the coins hammer the **nail** into the canvas, clang, clang, clang, while the boxers duck. When it bends, he Force-chokes the **nail** until it straightens, whimpering.

{Gandalf} strikes his staff in the {Basement} of the {Water Park} and conjures rain over the empty slides, but the spell misfires and a little thatched *roof* pops up to catch nearly all of it. Only a **few** drops get past: drip, drip. Cranky, he sets off his finest fireworks, and the crowd that comes is very **few**: one duck and a lonely inflatable flamingo.

{Homer} sneaks into the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} for a nap and finds one last doughnut on the sink. He lunges, it rolls down the drain, and with a "D'oh!" his *standing heart* sinks to his knees. Big *tears* fill the basin, and he paddles a finger in them. "What a **pity**," he sobs, and falls asleep, still mumbling "Mmm, **pity**."

{Sherlock} stands in {Front} of the {Wine Cellar} and deduces, from one cork, that the thief is caught in the *dragnet* Watson has just hauled up. Smugly lending a *helping hand*, he **throws down** the whole net, and barrels bounce away down the hill. Out climbs a startled goat, and Sherlock **throws down** his pipe in disgust.

{Darth Vader} stalks {Inside} the {Yeti Cave}, where *leaf pickers* are dropping leaves all over the floor. Disapproving, he raises one glove and the Force lifts each leaf onto a *folded blanket*, then another blanket, and they **pile up** until they touch the ceiling. "Impressive," he breathes, and makes them **pile up** on the sleeping yeti as well.

{Robocop} clanks into the {Basement} of the {Hut} and meets his *lookalike*, an identical armoured man, tapping a dent right over Robocop's steel *heart*. Directive Four says citizens must not **provoke** an officer. The lookalike recites the same directive in a sing-song voice, tap, tap, just to **provoke** him, so Robocop stiffly arrests him, and is stiffly arrested back.

{Yoshi} drops into the {Bathroom} of the {Museum} and finds a *dugout canoe* with a big *mouth* carved on its prow, droning that life is a canoe. That **analogy** bores him, so out flicks his tongue and down it all goes, gulp. He lays a speckled egg, and a tiny voice from the shell offers a better **analogy**: life is an egg.

{Pikachu} skitters into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, where a music **chart** hangs in a shaft of *broad daylight*. A *small speech bubble* floats off every note, and all of them say "Pika!", the only lyric he can read. His cheeks crackle, a Thunderbolt lights up the whole **chart**, and the pipes start to sing along.

{Kermit} flails into the {Bathroom} of the {Waiting Room} having shoved past the whole queue, and a *ghost* rises from the sink and taps his *standing heart*. His arms drop and his banjo droops. It's not easy being green, he mumbles, turning a deep, **ashamed** shade of olive, and he hops back to the end of the line, too **ashamed** to say "Yaaay".

{Homer} flops {Inside} the {Swamp} for a nap and uses a *golden crown* to toast a doughnut over a *campfire*. Then comes the dim scheme: he puts the hot crown on his bald head to keep it warm. His scalp turns so **radiant** that frogs squint and the mud shines, and with a "D'oh!" he finds he is now too **radiant** to sleep.

{Homer} waddles in {Front} of the {Waiting Room} after a trail of muddy *footsteps*, because they smell of doughnuts. They stop at a shiny **badge** on a lamp post, and his dim scheme is to pin it on and skip the queue for ever. Then the *footsteps* start up again, straight up his leg, and a tiny furious dog takes back its **badge**. "D'oh!"

{Robocop} wades {Inside} the {Lagoon}, finds a sugar cube loitering, and locks it in a glass *container*. Politely he reads it its rights, but *water drops* fall in and the suspect begins to **dissolve**. He repeats the charge, stiffly adds his handcuffs to secure it, and watches the evidence and the cuffs **dissolve** together in a fizz of bubbles.

The {Joker} cackles in the {Bathroom} of the {Waiting Room} and pulls a trick toilet chain, and a whole football *team* starts to **fall** through the floor. They land unhurt in soft *soil* and sprout like turnips, still in their kits. He deals a playing card to the receptionist, reading SURPRISE, and she and the potted fern **fall** after them, while he howls with laughter.

{Sherlock} stands in {Front} of the {Spa}, sniffing some glowing *embers*, and begins a long, smug deduction about who lit them. A bucket of water hisses over the coals, and his speech is **cut short**. Relighting his pipe, he tries his violin instead, but the *embers* spit, a string snaps, and that too is **cut short**.

{James Bond} steps out in {Front} of the {Inn} in a crisp tuxedo, and Q hands him a *towel* that does one absurd thing: it drinks anything it touches. He flicks the **towel** at a puddle, then the rainstorm, then a henchman's coffee. Unruffled, he tucks the whale-sized, dripping **towel** under one arm and remarks that he is quite dry now.

{Lara Croft} solves a stone puzzle in the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} and the ancient trap springs: *water drops* turn to torrents from every tap. The tub is **overflowing**, the sinks are **overflowing**, and an *inspector* in a raincoat floats past on his clipboard, writing it all down. She climbs the towel rail, ponytail dripping, and swings out through the window with the relic.

{Sailor Moon} spins through a long sparkly transformation in the {Basement} of the {Spa}, trips over a pipe, and cries so loudly that *water drops* **spray** from her eyes. They hit a *bird nest* on the valve and soak the birds, who **spray** her back with flapping wings. Luna the cat sighs and hides behind the boiler.

{Darth Vader} looms in the {Basement} of the {Pool}, where a *busy man* is shovelling *soil* at a drain, one tiny spadeful at a time. Finding this lack of progress disturbing, Vader raises a glove, and the Force hurls the whole heap at once to **block up** every pipe with a thud. The man, delighted, asks him to **block up** the taps as well.

{Cookie Monster} barges {Inside} the {Beehive} past a *queue* of bees, each carrying one shiny white *tile*. "Me want cookie!" he roars, and crunches one anyway: fine **porcelain**, crumbs everywhere, googly eyes spinning. It needs milk, he decides, so he devours the bees' whole **porcelain** tea set, and the queue starts again from the beginning.

The {Joker} sets up a *small table* in the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} and deals his trick cards, and each one starts to *chatter* a **spell** in a squeaky voice. The oars turn to rubber chickens and the boats to geese. Cackling, he squirts his flower to end the **spell**, but it only turns his green hair into seaweed.

{Yoshi} wriggles {Inside} the {Beach} and meets a *woman* in a feathered hat: his **aunt**, a champion *bowman* who shoots sandwich after sandwich at him. His sticky tongue snatches each one out of the air, and he lays it as an egg. She pinches his cheek, pockets the eggs and fires again; nobody ever finishes lunch with this **aunt**.

{Batman} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar}, where pilots present him with a whole *tree* as a *tribute*. Brooding, he reaches into his utility belt, pulls out a tiny Bat-Lathe and carves a huge **club** in seconds. He growls that he is the night, swings the **club** once, and bats a helicopter clean out of the door.

{James Bond} sandboards into the {Bathroom} of the {Dunes} in his tuxedo, where a *lord* on a sandy *hillside* gloats that he owns the whole **county**. Bond clicks Q's latest cufflink, which does one absurd thing: it moves borders. The line slides past the lord's slippers, and Bond adjusts his tie. "You seem to have mislaid your **county**."

{Yoshi} pops up in the {Bathroom} of the {Museum}, where warm *water drops* fill a tiny *valley* between two display cases. His tongue shoots out and swallows the whole **bath**, bubbles, rubber duck and all. A moment later he lays a huge blue egg, cracks it open, and there is the **bath** again, with a mummy already soaking in it.

{Mario} warps out of a pipe in the {Bathroom} of the {Lake} and leaps to stomp a *woman* who has one *raised brow*. She is so **charming** that his stomp turns into a curtsy in midair, and he head-butts a block just to offer her the coin. The brow lifts higher, and even the block blushes and pays out ten more: that is how **charming** she is.

{Sailor Moon} trips in {Front} of the {Pool} over a dried-up *fish* lying beside a limp *grain stalk*, and bursts into loud tears. Then she raises her moon wand, gives a long speech about justice for seafood, and sparkles rain down to **revive** it. The fish gasps and flips; the stalk stands tall and waves, and she goes on to **revive** a fainting lifeguard.

{Homer} trudges {Inside} the {Wine Cellar} hunting a snack, following *water drops* and a *sparrow* carrying his stolen doughnut. His dim scheme is to pull the plug in the floor, and in gushes the wide **Huai River**, barges and all, the old line between north and south China. With a "D'oh!" he floats off on a barrel, and the sparrow steers him down the **Huai River**.

{Casper} floats shyly in {Front} of the {Island} and waves at a bush of *mugwort*, only wanting a friend. A *mouth* in the leaves yells **Hey**, and he turns invisible in fright. He drifts back through a palm tree and tries a small **hey** of his own, and every islander runs away screaming, leaving poor Casper sighing on the sand.

{Pikachu} scampers into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach}, where a *lying man* snores between a pair of *twins*. A thunderous **fart** shakes the sand, and the twins point at each other. "Pika?" His cheeks crackle, a stray Thunderbolt zaps the air, and the next **fart** goes off like a firework and lifts the man an inch off his towel.

{Chewbacca} roars in {Front} of the {Beach} because his ship needs sealing, and rips a branch off a *lacquer tree*. Sticky *water drops* of red sap run down his bandolier, and he slathers **lacquer** over the hull, the seagulls and his own fur. Then he sticks fast to the ship and growls something only Han understands: too much **lacquer**.

{Yoshi} sits {Inside} the {Inn} as a *greedy claw* pokes through the ceiling and hoards all the *water drops* leaking from the tub upstairs. That is **excessive**, so out shoots his tongue, and he swallows the claw, the buckets, the soup and the fish tank. He lays egg after egg until the staircase is blocked: an **excessive** clutch, and the innkeeper paddles out in a pot.

{Charlie Brown} flies his kite {Inside} the {Tower} stairwell and, naturally, it gets eaten: a giant *nest* of sticks swallows it whole. He sighs "Good grief" and climbs up to fetch it, and the **nest** collapses gently around him. The mother bird comes home, sits on him all night, and Charlie becomes the only boy ever to wait for hatching in a **nest**.

{Frodo} limps in {Front} of the {Funfair} after a very long walk, and a huge painted *mouth* over the gate demands the Ring. Tempted, he slips it on instead and, invisible, begins to **order** everyone about in a booming voice: ride the coaster, share that *cut cake*, bow to the Ferris wheel. Sam prises it off his finger, but the clowns still beg for more **orders**.

The {Joker} pops up in the {Bathroom} of the {Swan Pond}, where a *kneeling pair* of swans holds out a quill. A rubber *helping hand* on a spring grabs it and starts to **compose** an ode full of whoopee jokes about honking. He signs it with his squirting flower, ink hits him in the eye, and the swans cheerfully **compose** a very rude review.

{Shrek} bursts into the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café} wanting peace, but a *stern face* on the wall puckers its *mouth* and begins to **whistle**. Cats fly off the shelves and teacups crack. Shrek has had enough of this: he roars, stuffs two green fingers between his lips and starts to **whistle** louder, blowing Donkey, still talking, out through the window.

The {Joker} sneaks into the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive} and cinches a trick *belt* round the tub, and the *water drops* stop dead in midair. The whole pool turns **stagnant**, green and silent, which is his idea of a great joke. He cackles and squirts his flower, but even the squirt hangs there, **stagnant**, until a bee tows it away.

{Mario} warps {Inside} the {Lake} castle and jumps on a block that a *king* is poking with his *cane*. Instead of a coin, out pops a red **rose**. "Wahoo!" He head-butts the block again and again, until the king is buried in petals and sneezing, and his cane sprouts one last thorny **rose** as a thank-you.

{Sherlock} drops into the {Bathroom} of the {Warehouse}, inspects a *stone* tablet through his magnifying glass, and deduces from one chipped corner that it is a diploma. A single *page* glued to it confirms the fact: a **master's degree** in Being Right. He plays himself a victory tune on the violin while Watson staggers behind him, carrying the enormous **master's degree**.

{Darth Vader} looms in the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café} and, needing no rod, raises one glove to **fish** with the Force. A soup *ladle* baited with *gold coins* floats out over the giant milk bowl, and he hauls in a tabby, a cupcake and the barista, breathing loudly throughout. The cats, insulted, set off to **fish** for his cape.

{Darth Vader} stomps {Inside} the {Yeti Cave} and flicks a pile of *leaves* aside with the Force, uncovering one shy *bug*. "I am your father," he booms, and the appalled bug unfolds into a **butterfly** as wide as a carpet. He cannot choke it, for it is no object. It settles on his helmet, and the **butterfly** slows his breathing to a sigh.

{Shrek} tramps in {Front} of the {Beach} looking for a quiet spot, trips on a *lacquer tree*, and bangs his **knee**. He roars, the tree drips sticky sap, and Donkey is glued to his leg. The *moon* gleams on the shiny green swelling all night while Donkey, who will not shut up, tells stories from his **knee**.

{Yoshi} waddles {Inside} the {Tower}, where a *woman* hands him a *cracked shell* scratched with the surname **Yao**. He gulps it down and flutter-jumps up the stairs, laying an egg on each landing. Every egg hatches a small relative of hers, and they all shout their name. "Yoshi!" he protests, and "**Yao**!" they yell back.

{Mario} warps into the {Bathroom} of the {Tower}, drops his super mushroom, and a tuft of *grass* in the sink gobbles it and goes **luxuriant**. He stomps it, and it springs back. He swings a *pole axe*, and with each "Wahoo!" every stalk returns twice as **luxuriant**, lifting his red cap to the ceiling.

{Chewbacca} storms in {Front} of the {Museum} in a temper, roars at an ancient marble *torso*, and rips off the *district map* wrapped round it. Sorry at once, he sticks the map all over his own hairy **body**, ankles to ears. Lost tourists now comb through his fur for directions, and every street in town runs along his **body**.

{Lara Croft} rappels into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} after a relic and finds a tiny *clerk* guarding it at a desk. This **minor official** demands a permit for every trap, and even the rolling boulder must wait for its stamp. She backflips over his paperwork, snatches the relic, and the **minor official** stamps the boulder as it rumbles by.

{Yoshi} prowls {Inside} the {Mint} and spots a *prowling dog* in a *long robe* creeping past the coin presses. His tongue whips the robe away, and the dog is really an **ape**, howling in surprise as it goes down in one gulp. He lays an egg that promptly sprouts long arms, and the **ape** swings off with a sack of coins.

The {Joker} skips into the {Bathroom} of the {Island} and plants a *bare tree*, sharpened like a pencil, then shuffles his trick cards. Each card he flicks turns into another trunk, until a wooden **stockade** rings the pirates' lunch. They snarl and climb the **stockade**, and every trunk squirts them in the face while he howls with laughter.

{Sherlock} deduces in the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, from a single thread, that Watson stole his deerstalker, and prepares a smug speech. An *echo* from the drain repeats every word, and hearing it, his *heart* softens. "Elementary, my dear friend, I **forgive** you." The echo booms **forgive** so loudly that Watson bursts into tears and hands back the hat.

{Chewbacca} is fixing a leaky ship {Inside} the {Museum} when he loses his temper and rips a long trench through the floor to drain it: a **canal**, past mummies and dinosaurs. Still growling, he tears a *tree* out of the atrium and rows it along the *canal* like a gondola. The **canal** soon pours into the café, flooding the cappuccinos.

{Chewbacca} bellows in {Front} of the {Beach}, and from over the waves his hairy **relatives** bellow back, landing by the shipload. Grandfather hacks the cake with a *pole axe*, cousins hurl *soybean* snacks, and everyone roars in a language only family understands. The hugs snap his bandolier, and still the **relatives** keep coming until the sand sinks.

{Charlie Brown} finally wins a prize {Inside} the {Funfair}, and it is a giant *clam* with a dragon curled up in it, booming "I am the **fifth Earthly Branch**." He sets up his football for a celebratory kick. Good grief: the dragon pulls it away at the last second, and the **fifth Earthly Branch** laughs at him as he lands flat on his back.

{Batman} broods {Inside} the {Fort} as a *white dove* tows in a tiny *boat*, which grows and grows on the ribbon into an ocean-going **ship**. Suspicious, he fires his grappling hook into the mast and ties the other end to the Batmobile. The dove drops onto his cowl, exhausted, and he growls that the **ship** is impounded.

{Batman} stands in {Front} of the {Mansion} with a launcher from his utility belt, about to **issue** the annual awards. He slips a *page* into every slice of *cut cake* and fires them out like batarangs: best moustache, loudest sneeze, most polite pigeon. Alfred, who is **issued** only a crumb and a blank sheet, sulks behind the lamp post.

{Homer} naps {Inside} the {Swamp} and wakes to see the *golden crown* he borrowed for a dim scheme sinking into the mud. "D'oh!" His *standing heart* leaps out of his chest and paces up and down in pure **anxiety**. Homer knows only one cure, so he eats twelve doughnuts while the frogs around him croak with **anxiety**.

{Homer} dozes on an inflatable ring {Inside} the {Pool} when a *prowling dog* rolls up with a *melon* and swaps it for his doughnut. He bites the melon: "D'oh!" That was no dog but a **fox** in disguise, so he sets a dim trap with a second doughnut. The **fox** eats the bait, winks, and swims off with his towel.

{Frodo} limps into the {Basement} of the {Jungle} temple after a very long walk, and the *wind* blows in a *small speech bubble* mocking his hairy toes. Parrots **satirize** his weary sigh, his bare feet, his staring at the Ring. He slips it on and tiptoes off invisible, and the parrots **satirize** that too, by covering their eyes and bumping into walls.

{Batman} grapples into the {Bathroom} of the {Funfair} and, as a disguise from his utility belt, straps on a clump of *bamboo* planted upside down, *roots* waving like hair. Children point and laugh at how **dumb** he looks. The world's greatest detective growls that this is not a **dumb** plan, turns with a brooding swirl of his cape, and walks straight into the door.

{Pikachu} sparks open a mysterious *parcel* {Inside} the {Tower} and finds one folded *shirt*. A single jolt of static and it unrolls into a long silk **gown**, trailing down twelve flights of stairs. "Pika!" He sweeps up the steps with his tail in the air, and the crackling **gown** stands out all round him like a yellow balloon.

{Charlie Brown} trudges {Inside} the {Tower} to show his kite to the *royal court*, and a giant *mouth* over the throne starts to **ridicule** his zigzag shirt. "Good grief," he mumbles, and the kite falls apart in his hands. The whole court joins in to **ridicule** him, and even Snoopy, up on a pillar, snickers.

{Frodo} drags his bare hairy feet in {Front} of the {Lake} after three weeks of walking and collapses, until Sam hands him a steaming *coffee*. One sip and his feet blur: he circles the lake forty times, hair on end. The fish swim at double speed, and even the Ring seems to whisper for more **coffee**. Nobody sleeps that week: too much **coffee**.

{Pikachu} hops onto a *launch pad* in {Front} of the {Fort} and charges it with a Thunderbolt. It fires a barrel of *water drops* into the sky, which bursts overhead and starts to **splash** him, shorting out his cheeks. "Pika!" Soggy but stubborn, he fires again and manages to **splash** the guards, the flag and himself once more.

{Shrek} stomps {Inside} the {Yen Exchange} to a busy *crossroads* of traders with Donkey yapping behind him. Genius strikes: he stacks *gold coins* between Donkey's teeth, since a donkey forced to **hold in mouth** a fortune cannot talk. Blessed silence, for one moment. Then Donkey mumbles on through the coins, and soon every banker has to **hold in mouth** his money to hear him.

{James Bond} slips into the {Bathroom} of the {Mint}, where a *standing person* has been reading an endless *scroll* of coin numbers for nine years, utterly **weary**. Unruffled, Bond offers to take over and gives Q's pocket pillow to the man, who collapses snoring. Two lines later, Bond is **weary** too. "The name's Bond. James..." he says, and sleeps.

{Homer} lounges {Inside} the {Mansion} as the pipes burst, and his dim scheme is to **contain** all the *water drops* in one doughnut box. In go the fountain, the goldfish and a rubber duck, and he sits on the lid and says "Mmm." The box can **contain** it for four seconds, and then it fires him through the chandelier. "D'oh!"

{Chewbacca} skids into the {Bathroom} of the {Ice Rink}, and his huge roar blows a *sparrow* out of a towel. Sorry at once, he lifts it in one gentle *pinch*: a **small bird** no bigger than a thimble. He tucks it into his bandolier and carries it everywhere, and soon the **small bird** is roaring back at everybody.

{Shrek} stomps {Inside} the {Dunes} and tells Donkey he wants just *ten days* of silence. Donkey lasts four minutes, so Shrek scratches a line in the sand and starts the **ten-day period** over. {Yoshi} clambers {Inside} the {Tower} to a hot *cave* at the top, where a glowing **kiln** roars. {Naruto} crashes into the {Bathroom} of the {Yeti Cave} yelling that he never gives up, and slips into a pit of *black mud*. {Chewbacca} repairs the broken vault in {Front} of the {Yen Exchange}, patching it with *two sheaves* of wheat, and saves the whole economy. {Homer} snoozes {Inside} the {Hangar} under a willow *tree* wearing a scholar's *high collar*, and it points a branch at the nearest cargo plane. {Batman} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} in a new stealth cape stitched from *rags* and *grass*. It hides him perfectly; the **drawback** is that it does not glide, so he lands in the sink. {Shrek} roars in {Front} of the {Dunes}, wanting only to be left alone, and his roar startles a falling camel into the arms of an *employee* with a *strong arm*. {Gandalf} arrives in {Front} of the {Water Park}, mutters a spell, and a *standing knife* hops up and begins to **scrape** the moss off the slides. The moss sticks out a long green *tongue* at him. {James Bond} sits with *crossed legs* in {Front} of the {Cat Café} and presses Q's newest button, which does one absurd thing: it ejects his chair over a green *hillside* into the **suburbs**. {Chewbacca} sits in {Front} of the {Beach} as *icicles* grow on a fisherman's *wife*, who has been waiting for his boat through the snow. {Pikachu} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Jungle} temple, where a stone *helping hand* holds out a *tribute* of rubies. The {Joker} cackles in {Front} of the {Swan Pond} and hands a swan a rigged *spindle*, which spins a lump of *stone* into a rubber **brick** for pranking passers-by. {Darth Vader} strides into the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring}, raises a glove and Force-lifts a great bronze **cauldron** by its three *cauldron legs*. {Lara Croft} swings {Inside} the {Mansion} on a chandelier with a *bamboo* **basket** of stolen relics on her back, and lands in the path of a fussy *inspector*. The {Joker} stands in {Front} of the {Jungle} lodge and stuffs *grass* into a joke basket over a bonfire, and *rising steam* billows from his squirting flower. {Batman} roars into the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} in the Batmobile, which skids along a pair of *linked rails* and runs over a mound of dough, pressing it into a huge **flat cake**. {Mario} warps into the {Basement} of the {Pool} and head-butts a block, and out flies a *lid* with a tiny *rice field* folded under it.
